race.comment: PROFIT MOTIVE (2) came from off the speed to win fresh before bolting in by the biggest margin we've ever had in the Burgess Queen. Drawn out this time, but has shown plenty of versatility and she looks to have a very high ceiling. Hard to see anything turning the tables on her here. TREASURED LEGACY (3) chased PROFIT MOTIVE home in the Burgess Queen and jumped favourite ahead of Roger two back in Open 3YO company. Out to the mile looks a big tick for her, although she has also drawn wide. Pike riding is a bonus and she can put her best foot forward again. CASSANDRA (11) gets the blinkers on for the first time today and her recent efforts have suggested she's wanted the mile for a long time now. She was good late in the Burgess Queen and she can feature again at odds. QUEDJINUP (8) sat wide and hit the line alongside CASSANDRA last start. Has to be included. DIXIE DOO (7) bolted in last start at her first try at a mile. Tougher here but she has upside.
